title: Ryan Reynolds Dressed as Deadpool and Walked Around Comic-Con — and Nobody Knew!
summary: Have you ever dreamed of bumping into your favorite superhero? At Comic-Con this weekend, some fans got the surprise of a lifetime. They thought they were taking photos with a really good Deadpool cosplayer. But it was actually Ryan Reynolds — the real actor who plays Deadpool in the movies! Reynolds wore a gray denim Deadpool suit instead of the usual red one. He walked around the convention floor with no security guards, no helpers — just him and the fans. He took selfies, chatted, and soaked up the excitement. Later, he posted a video saying, 'No handlers, no security, no ropes. WHAT A GIFT.' He even crashed the big Marvel presentation. Robert Downey Jr. spotted him and joked, 'Who's this guy with the swords and stuff?' Reynolds played along, pretending to be a random caller. So what's next for Deadpool? Reynolds says there will 'eventually' be another movie, but this time Deadpool might not be the main star. He thinks the character is great in a group, like a supporting player. He also wants to include some 'deep cuts' — cool comic book stories that haven't been in the movies yet. For now, fans are still buzzing about his surprise appearance. It was a reminder that sometimes, the best moments happen when a star just wants to have fun with the people who made him famous.
why_it_matters: Even famous movie stars sometimes want to just have real, unplanned fun with the people who support them, showing that they are real people too.

questions.question: What did Ryan Reynolds say about his time walking around without handlers?

background_read: Comic-Con is a huge event that happens every year where fans dress up as superheroes, meet movie stars, and see new trailers.
Ryan Reynolds (the actor who plays Deadpool) is famous for joking around in costume, and he has done other surprise visits before.
Robert Downey Jr., well-known for playing Iron Man, was also at the event; he and Reynolds have both been part of big Marvel movies.
Article_Structure: WHO: Ryan Reynolds, the real actor behind Deadpool, and the fans at Comic-Con.
WHAT: He secretly walked around the convention dressed as Deadpool in a gray suit, took selfies, and later surprised the Marvel presentation.
WHERE: On the convention floor at Comic-Con.
WHY: He wanted to have fun with fans on his own, without security or helpers, and enjoy the special energy of the event.

perspectives.description: The fans who met him felt incredibly lucky and shared their stories everywhere, making the moment even more memorable.
Some might feel that a big star walking around without security could have caused problems or distracted from the official Marvel announcements.
Surprise appearances like this make Comic-Con unforgettable and give people a happy, unexpected moment that becomes part of convention history.
